cohort: The study included 342 female patients with systemic sclerosis from the Chinese Organization for Scleroderma, with a subset of pregnancies matched to healthy controls for comparison.
finding: Female patients with systemic sclerosis exhibit significant impairment in reproductive health, including earlier menopausal age, higher rates of spontaneous abortions, premature births, and low birth weight infants compared to national data or healthy controls.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was significantly increased in pregnancies of patients with systemic sclerosis compared to healthy controls (49.1% vs 19.1%, P < 0.001).
